newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK OF CRETE AUDIT COMPLETED, TENDER AFTER EASTER.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF CRETE AUDIT COMPLETED, TENDER AFTER EASTER.

text.p: The Bank of Crete said on Monday the international auditors retained by the bank had completed their audit and the information memorandum including the new terms on the sale is being worked on.

The bank expects the tender for its sale will be published in the Greek and international press after the Orthodox Easter, around May 3-4, it said in a statement. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
